run_findings.required_workflow_live_counterexample: A public ordinary schedule run in canonical/github-runner-operator exposed exact referenced_workflows source provenance. Exact target-head plus source workflow identity is diagnostic evidence, not ruleset attribution.
run_findings.required_workflow_rule_suite: GitHub Repository Rule Suites are authoritative ruleset/rule evaluations only when exact ref+after_sha is independently bound to the intended effect. Required-workflow PASS/BLOCKED uses the exact applicable ruleset's active workflows evaluation, not top-level suite result or ordinary run provenance.
run_findings.rule_suite_evaluate_distinction: Current Rule Suite API exposes pass/fail/bypass and active/evaluate distinctions. GitHub's documented examples show top-level result can differ from evaluation_result and detailed suites can contain enforcement=evaluate failures; verifier v3 therefore keeps only exact active workflows evaluations eligible for this family.
run_findings.merge_effect_binding: Successful synchronous merge returns exact landed SHA M; authoritative merged-PR read can recover actual M after an ambiguous response while causal attribution remains separate. Async success can expose M after UUID/intent reconciliation; failure lacks a documented exact effect SHA binding.
run_findings.queue_stack_boundary: One terminal async OID is not assumed to cover every Rule Suite in merge-queue/stack execution; complete group/final-base mapping is required.
run_findings.verifier_v3: VERIFIER_20260829_0224_POLICY_TRI_STATE_V3.py removes the source-run required-workflow false-positive and requires effect-bound active Rule Suite evaluation. Embedded fixtures were not separately executed in this invocation.
run_findings.capability_fingerprint_v5: CAPABILITY_FINGERPRINT_20260829_0224_V5.py revises the auth lattice: exact authoritative access-review allow/deny is OPERATION_AUTH_*_AT_OBSERVATION, not effect success or a permission lease. Only an exact successful operation plus bound result/readback reaches PROVED_EFFECT_FOR_TESTED_INVOCATION. Embedded fixtures were not separately executed in this invocation.
run_findings.kubernetes_ssar: Current Kubernetes SelfSubjectAccessReview is an exact current-principal operation-bound authorization query. Status.allowed/denied/reason/evaluationError is server-generated; authorization occurs before admission, so allowed=true still does not prove a later mutation will succeed or that authorization is leased.
run_findings.kubernetes_rules_review_negative_pattern: Current SelfSubjectRulesReview documentation explicitly warns external systems not to use broad enumerated permissions for authorization because results may be incomplete and have confused-deputy/cache-lifetime/revocation/correctness risks; use access-review APIs for authorization decisions instead.
run_findings.github_role_vs_operation_counterexample: On exact owned bachikoljunior-blip/note, read-only metadata/collaborator evidence says admin/push but repository Rule Suite read returns 403 Resource not accessible by integration. Repository role therefore does not imply credential authorization for Administration-read. A separate rulesets endpoint returned a plan/feature 403, so 403 provenance must remain operation-specific.
run_findings.filesystem_dynamic_scope: Exact Filesystem MCP implementation enforces mutable allowed directories and exposes a current-scope observation but no revision/epoch/lease. Current MCP Roots is deprecated/informational; implementation enforcement, not Roots itself, is the authorization evidence.
